user.title: Set up Desky Desk
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your Desky desk, or leave empty to scan for devices.

confirm.title: Confirm Device
confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} at address {address}?

pick_device.title: Choose Device
pick_device.description: Select your Desky desk from the list of discovered devices.

data_description.standing_threshold: The desk counts as standing when it stops at or above this height, in cm.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the desk at {address}

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to the desk: {error}

device_not_found.message: Could not find the desk at {address}. Make sure it is powered on and in Bluetooth range

height_out_of_range.message: {height} cm is outside the desk's allowed range of {min}-{max} cm

limit_inverted_lower.message: The lower limit of {height} cm must be below the upper limit of {other} cm

limit_inverted_upper.message: The upper limit of {height} cm must be above the lower limit of {other} cm

limit_out_of_range.message: {height} cm is outside the range a limit can be set to, {min}-{max} cm

no_desk_targeted.message: The action does not target a Desky desk

clear_height_limits.name: Clear height limits
clear_height_limits.description: Removes both height limits from the desk.

move_to_height.name: Move to height
move_to_height.description: Moves the desk to a height, within its height limits if they are set.

set_height_limit.name: Set height limit
set_height_limit.description: Sets the desk's upper or lower height limit.
